blocks.text: READ: Follow Inquirer Sports’ special coverage of the Aichi-Nagoya Asian Games 2026 NAGOYA–Uzbekistan’s Nodirbek Shavkatov on Sunday became the first medalist at the Asian Games 2026 in Japan to test positive for doping, testers said. Shavkatov, who won bronze in mixed martial arts in Aichi-Nagoya, is the third athlete at the Games to fail a drugs test. Shavkatov has been provisionally suspended after testing positive for the banned substance meldonium, the International Testing Agency said.
